notices.title: Changes to Homework Reminder Uploads on eClass
notices.summary: From 4 January 2027 the school will no longer upload homework to eClass for P.4-P.6 students, while the current practice continues for P.1-P.3, to encourage students to take greater ownership of their learning and build self-leadership (a key focus of the new three-year School Development Plan, as shared at the P.1-P.6 Parents' Day on 3 October 2026). Reply slip to sign by 23 November 2026. Enquiries: Vice Principal Ms. Claudia Tsang (ctsang@mps.edu.hk) or IT Team Head Mr. Gordon Chan (gchan@mps.edu.hk).

notices.title: Service Demand Survey of School-based After School Care Service Scheme 「在校課後託管服務計劃」服務需求調查
notices.summary: Survey of demand for the School-based After School Care Service Scheme, which the Labour and Welfare Bureau, Social Welfare Department and Education Bureau will regularise across all publicly funded primary schools from 2027/28. The scheme provides after-school care and homework tutoring on campus (generally 3 hours/day, tutor-to-student ratio 1:8, 1:5 for SEN students) for P.1-P.6 students whose parents cannot arrange after-school care. Standard fee HK$1,700 per student per month, with a full fee waiver for CSSA, full-rate Working Family Allowance, full-level student financial assistance, or low-income families (household income at or below 55% of median monthly domestic household income). Reply slip (apply / do not apply, with reasons) due 22 November 2026.

notices.title: The Hong Kong Budding Poets (English) Award 2026/27
notices.summary: The Hong Kong Budding Poets (English) Award 2026/27 — a territory-wide English poetry competition organised by HKAGE and supported by the Education Bureau. Interested students submit one poem (max 40 lines) per section, hard copy to Ms. A. Lam by 18 January 2027; the school may nominate students if entries exceed 40 per school. Reply slip due 23 November 2026.

notices.title: Family Day Outing – Kai Tak Joypolis Sports (啟德JP超動感世界)
notices.summary: PTA Family Day Outing to Kai Tak Joypolis Sports on Saturday 5 December 2026, 12:15–3:30 pm; HK$250 per participant (adults and children same price), capacity 350 with a lottery if oversubscribed. Reply slip and crossed cheque (payable to 'Marymount Primary School Parent-Teacher Association') to the class teacher by 20 November 2026. Families with more than one daughter at MPS register under the eldest sister's name.

notices.title: Introduction of the Self-directed Putonghua Learning App “Star Reading”(星靈伴讀)
notices.summary: Introduces the self-directed Putonghua learning app 'Star Reading' (星靈伴讀), available 13 November 2026 to 31 August 2027 with a Reading Reward Scheme; free to parents (Government grant covers the subscription). Reply slip to sign by 19 November 2026.

notices.title: Family Connect – Expressing Love and Support (Summative Assessment 1)
notices.summary: Write an encouraging message on a card and present your daughter with a certificate 'In Recognition of Persistent Effort'; submit photos of the message and presentation via Google Form by 4 December 2026 to earn 10 Family Connect credits. Reply slip to sign by 4 December 2026.

notices.title: Parent Education – FAMILY CONNECT
notices.summary: Introduces the FAMILY CONNECT parent education programme (talks and workshops, parent-child activities, volunteer service and sharing) with a credit award scheme; 10 credits per activity, certificates at 50/60/70 annual credits. Reply slip to sign by 20 November 2026.

notices.title: MSS MPS Centenary Raffle Tickets Sale
notices.summary: Return the completed reply slip (hard copy), payment, raffle ticket stubs and unsold tickets on or before 23 November 2026.
